component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() base = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FernandoHaeser/roku-emulator/develop/docs/assets/" m.url = base + "home-screen.png" m.missingUrl = base + "missing.png" m.posters = {} watch("first", m.url, true) end sub
sub watch(name as string, uri as string, attach as boolean) poster = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Poster") poster.id = name m.posters[name] = poster poster.observeField("loadStatus", "onStatus") if attach then m.top.appendChild(poster) poster.uri = uri print name; " set "; poster.loadStatus; " "; poster.bitmapWidth; "x"; poster.bitmapHeight end sub
sub onStatus(event as object) poster = event.getRoSGNode() status = event.getData() print poster.id; " -> "; status; " "; poster.bitmapWidth; "x"; poster.bitmapHeight if status = "loading" then return if poster.id = "first" then watch("missing", m.missingUrl, true) else if poster.id = "missing" then watch("again", m.url, true) else if poster.id = "again" then watch("detached", m.url, false) else print "done" m.top.done = true end if end sub
